_about: Rule constants and wording for the YUDDH ruleset. Edit values here; the engine reads them.

morale._about: A unit routs when a blow leaves it at or below 1/lineDivisor of its maximum health (rounded up) and it was above that line before. Routed units flee to the Rajya line and take no action in their owner's next turn.

ai._about: The search AI (level 'search'): each turn it beam-searches its own action sequences on a copy of the board, with unseen cards re-dealt at random, then plays the opponent's reply and scores where that leaves it. Bigger numbers play better and think longer.

sharad.name: Sharad
sharad.rule: The campaigning season: clear skies, firm ground. No special rule.

varsha.name: Varsha
varsha.rule: Mud: cavalry and chariots cannot charge. Every unit advances or attacks, not both.

grishma.name: Grishma
grishma.rule: Heat haze: ranged units deal 1 less damage (never less than 1).

hemanta.name: Hemanta
hemanta.rule: Full granaries: every turn, both treasuries hold 1 extra Kosha.
